name: Huapont Life Sciences Co.,Ltd.
summary: Huapont Life Sciences Co.,Ltd. engages in the medicine, medical care, agrochemicals, new materials, tourism, and other businesses in China and internationally. It is involved in the production and sale of pharmaceutical preparations and raw materials. The company also offers medicines for skin, tuberculosis, anti-infection, respiratory, anti-tumor, and cardiovascular, as well as health management products. In addition, it provides pesticide technical, intermediate and preparation products, and GLP registration technical services.
